caption: The drawing depicts a painted wooden figure of a man standing on a green rectangular base. The man is dressed in a dark brown or black textured jacket, a yellow vest with double rows of buttons, and cream-colored trousers. He wears black boots and a wide-brimmed, dark brown or black hat with a blue band. A red scarf is tied around his neck and he is holding a brass or brown-colored telescope up to his right eye with his right hand, while his left arm hangs down by his side. The man’s face is light-skinned, and the background is plain and light-colored, with a faint rectangular border around the figure.
title: Ship Chandler's Sign
